title: Wall Handstand Push-Up
summary: A vertical push-up in a handstand against a wall, a demanding bodyweight shoulder press.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for front delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.7 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.4 for side delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Lower your head to the floor
Use a mat under your head and lower slowly.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
